description: Fast modular arithmetic and wide-limb multiplication for secp256r1

instructions.name: secp256r1.mult
instructions.semantics: Performs a 256x256-bit multiplication of two 8-word integers. in[0..7] is the left operand and in[8..15] is the right operand. The 512-bit result is written to out[0..15].

instructions.name: secp256r1.mmod
instructions.semantics: Performs a 512-bit to 256-bit fast modular reduction for secp256r1. The 512-bit product is read from in[0..15]. The 256-bit reduced result is written to out[0..7] and zero-padded to out[15].

name: MicroECC secp256r1 Extension
